name: Mobis Parts America PDC - South Windsor CT

fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, guard booth, or perimeter fence is visible at the Sullivan Ave driveway or the truck-court entrance in z19/z20 satellite, nor from Street View of the public road. A driver-info listing (warehouserating.com) states 'the location has a gate' with first-come-first-served check-in - this may refer to an interior control point not resolvable from imagery, or be outdated. Classified false on the rubric (open driveway with no visible control), flagged medium-confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure visible anywhere; flagged given the imagery/web discrepancy.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single shared driveway off Sullivan Ave serves entry and exit; the Mobis monument sign marks this driveway.
fieldNotes.dropYard: A separate row of drop trailers (no tractors) sits beyond the active dock staging along the SE court.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~36 dock doors along the single SE building face (band 25-50).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Drop trailers parked in the shared SE court; estimate 10-25 band.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long, wide dock-court approach holding 3+ trucks.

citations.claim: Mobis Parts America active Material Processor / Warehouse Safety Specialist PDC requisitions in South Windsor, CT (Mobis ATS-sourced).

verification.rationale: Northeast/Hartford PDC (292,000 SF build-to-suit by Scannell, hence leased); active 2026 Mobis careers postings in South Windsor CT, no closure/relocation signal.
